body: Commits 870935a/6d31288 on main. Found while investigating an unrelated rendering question: scripts/build.sh -- the script every 'build clean' claim this session relied on -- never built apps/arena/src/main.c (the actual human GUI client), only scripts/build_arena.sh did. Checked it does compile clean (pre-existing warnings only), so no broken commits, just an unverified claim. Folded the gcc invocation into build.sh. Verified via full rm -rf build + rebuild from scratch. Full suite green.
title: Fix scripts/build.sh to actually build apps/arena (S170-186)
